$comment: Conformance corpus for Spatial MCP v0.1. Each entry names an artifact file and what a conformant validator must say about it: `valid` is the required verdict, `mustFlag` lists error paths a validator MUST report for an invalid artifact (it may report more), and `mustLint` lists data-minimization findings the reference lint reports (lint findings are advisory and never affect validity). Run your implementation over every entry; if it disagrees with a required verdict or misses a mustFlag path, it is not conformant. Asset URLs use the reserved `assets.example` host: fixtures exercise the validator, they are not fetchable.

fixtures.note: only the three required fields; expect recommendation warnings, zero errors
every optional block populated the way three.ws forge tools emit it
unknown top-level field is a warning, never an error
conformant shape, but the meta block violates data minimization; the reference lint flags every listed path
